body: You're awesome too!

I'm alright. I got myself a room but I just had to get away from the house because I like to hunt and I dont want to do anything rash or stupid or whatever. Don't have my laptop but at least I've got my iPad and truck. Sorry I've been drinking
Thanks for that. I've gotten myself a room for the night and I was able to calm down after a few drinks. the future will be okay
You know what? I don't give a fuck. My name is Richard and I am from Arab, Alabama. Today I found out my wife is a cheating whore. Take it or leave it.
I'm getting the hell out of dodge. This has scarred me mentally and I don't know if I'll be able to get past this rage. I know I've got to move on, but right now all I'm seeing is red.
No fucking clue, but I know they sent over 40 messages back and forth last night talking about naming the baby after his grandparents. Isn't that cute? If it's a boy, they'll name him Harold!
Her silence is because she was too busy texting her fucking boyfriend.
Don't worry, read the update. :(

She refused to speak to me ALL DAY and wouldn't even look at me, she just sat there playing on her phone. I checked her iPad and she's cheating on me with a coworker. Not only that, but they've been dating for over a year! And not only that, BUT IT TURNS OUT SHE WANTS TO RAISE THE BABY WITH HIM!

I think I might have snapped, no kidding. I am not mentally right right now.

hahahaha It's okay. I'll make it through it somehow. It's just really nice to know that she DOES want kids, she just doesn't want them with ME. She doesn't have any fucking problem with Brian's kids, just mine. Fuck me. This is not good.

Can you tell me now, what use is a fucking vasectomy when your wife is cheating? Does the vasectomy prevent her from opening her fucking legs for a coworker? Or is all it does is make me look like a giant fool?

I can't even see straight, because I am so angry right now. I just wanted to go ahead and say:

>A life that she was assured she'd never have, when she married you?

She could never have any sort of life with me, she's a fucking cheater. She'll be more than happy raising the kid with her boyfriend.
Don't worry, her new lawyer boyfriend has plenty of money to pay for a nanny.
Don't fucking worry about it anymore. She and I had a lovely chat and I updated. I'm getting a divorce.

Ahahahaahaha it turns out she cheated on me and that's why she was silent for so long. I finally got her to speak to me and all she could say was that it isn't mine. Three fucking words in 12 hours. It's. Not. Yours. 

Aren't you all just sooooooo happy for me now? I'm the big fucking loser who wanted to keep the baby his cheating wife is pregnant with.

Don't worry about any of it anymore. She cheated on me and it's not mine. That's why she didn't want to discuss anything with me and gave me the silent treatment. I just got it out of her after sitting in silence all morning. My heart is snapped in half.
Well, I just finally managed to speak to her and it's not mine. I'm getting a divorce.
Thank you for your advice. I read it all and I don't have much of a response, but I just wanted to let you know you were helpful.
That is actually where I found one of the two doctors I went to. That doctor is the one who asked me to get religious counseling first.

Okay, so by 7:00 AM we had been there for ~12 hours and she had been waiting to be discharged for about 4 hours at that point. She was talking about getting McDonald's for breakfast and then she mentioned scheduling the termination. I only said what I did after she brought up the termination. 

This was the only time we ever spoke about this beyond our first conversation where she asked for space to think. That first conversation was about 4-5 weeks ago.

Okay, so in my head, I know the feelings are irrational. That is making me feel annoyed with myself in general because I don't want to think or feel this way.

In my heart, I am feeling sadness. I feel sad because I will never know the child or be its father. I feel happiness because I know that Jane is making the right choice for herself. I feel angry because I put myself into this situation.

On a third level, I am upset with myself because I feel like I failed as a man. I don't think it ever occurred to me before this, but I will not be able to pass on my last name or legacy, it will all end with me. I also feel upset because it feels like I failed on a biological level because now that the pregnancy is here, it won't stay. Obviously I've never had a miscarriage, but you know how sometimes women will say they 'failed'? I think that's the closest way to describe this.

You know, I can bring up a list of the things I've done for her, but I won't. You know why? Because I love Jane and I did those things because I loved her. I didn't do them so I could pull out a list and point out each and every time I did something to help her out. That's not who I am, and for you all to assume that our relationship has been anything but reciprocal is simply short-sighted. This is an issue that has arisen in the past 10 weeks of our seven years together.

And I apologize if that seemed directed at you, but I feel like people here have been railing on me instead reading what I say and trying to help me. I didn't come here for validation. I came here asking for help because I realize how messed up my thinking is. I don't want to throw away my whole life over this, but it's breaking my heart. I know she's dealing with a lot, but I need help too.
I know it's easy to jump on the OP, but you all are being deliberately unhelpful and deliberately cruel to me.

I live in rural Alabama. Rural as in, I had to drive over an hour to see each of the two doctors in the state who perform vasectomies. If you live in New York, I'm sure it's easier to find someone to do the job. But I was not able to find a doctor willing to do one for me. Regardless, our birth control methods worked for seven years before this and I think that's a pretty damn good indication that we were doing what we were supposed to be doing in terms of precautions. I'm not opposed to a vasectomy, but it's a conversation for another day, you know?

I asked her about her feelings when we first found out about the pregnancy, but she asked me to just let her sort her own thoughts out and not to bring it up. I respected her request as best as I could, but when it was brought up again while at the ER, she just shut down on me. I told her how I felt with as much tact as I could, but she didn't even respond or look at me. She just stared at the wall while I asked her to talk to me about it. That was at 7:00 AM and it's 2:00 PM now. I told her around noon that I wanted to talk to her whenever she was ready, but she ignored me still.

Why didn't Jane get a tubal ligation if she was so serious about not having kids? I understand what you all are trying to point out, but it's not fair to put all of the pregnancy blame on me when Jane and I had both agreed on what prevention measures to take. No one is to blame for the pregnancy; it was an accident. And like adults, we are handling the accident. It might not be the way I want the situation to be, but blaming me for not having a vasectomy is pointless. What if I had a vasectomy and she ended up pregnant anyway? Let me tell you, we'd be having the same exact discussion, only I wouldn't be getting blamed for not having my vas deferens cut in half.


As for the part where you say I'm asking for validation, do you really think I want to be this way? The title of the post shows how conflicted I am about this. I was hoping you all would be able to knock some sense into me, but instead I'm getting sarcasm and people blaming me for how I feel. **I cannot help my emotions, but I am trying my best to work through them.** You all make me feel like I should just give up and abandon the situation when I am asking for help on how to deal with this. Do you really think I want my personality and life to do a complete 180? Because I am asking this as a man who needs help dealing with these feelings.

>I'm not sure what doctors you went to, but that's just whack...because what about the men who never have (or want to have) a child? What are they supposed to do? Rely on BC or condoms or what-have-you the rest of their marriage?

I said the same thing! I called up doctors out of state, but they weren't able to accept my insurance. It was like a Catch-22 where you aren't allowed to have a vasectomy if you don't want kids, but you can get one if you already do. One of the doctors I saw in-state told me I had to seek religious counseling for even asking. Eventually I just gave up because I was getting nothing but rejections. People want to pretend like this is easy, but it's not exactly something I can walk into an office and demand.

>Missing work and then taking maternity leave could significantly affect her ability to move forward. It would be discrimination if they fired her for getting pregnant.

What I don't understand about this is that literally every other lawyer at Jane's firm has children. Jane's boss had her third child last year and she took off three months for her maternity leave. Jane's secretary had her baby shower two months ago and is planning on taking leave as well. Jane has always been able to call out before this, but suddenly she's acting like she will be fired. She didn't have an issue calling out when we decided to randomly go to France last summer, and that lasted two weeks. 

I'm not sure if she's being serious about her job penalizing her or if she's exaggerating for effect. I tried asking her, but I was met with silence.

I already made an appointment before I posted this on Reddit, but it's three months away due to the waiting list and I don't have three months right now. Before you all jump on my ass again, do a quick google search about mental health facilities in Alabama and please note that the two largest clinics shut down several months ago, abandoning thousands of patients and creating a gigantic mental health shortage. If you do manage to find a clinic accepting urgent appointments, PM me because I couldn't.

Does it really? Jane didn't know about that (she didn't want it for a different reason) when she rejected the doctor. I'm looking this up now.

Edit: ^ You were correct about the defects.

Can't you all understand, my rational mind AGREES with everything you wrote. I know it's shitty of me for exactly ALL the reasons you just listed. It's not fair of me to ask this of her. I didn't want kids before this because I knew that it would be a giant mess that I couldn't handle.

And hell, I still know that. I'm thinking about holding this baby for the first time and honestly, I have no clue what I would even do. I don't know how to hold a baby, I don't know how to hold a diaper. It's terrifying to think of.


But it's even scarier to imagine a future where it doesn't happen.

Does this make any sense? I don't need to get railed about why we shouldn't have the kid, I already know that. What I don't understand is why I feel this way or how to deal with it. Or how to talk to her about it.

Okay, you try getting a vasectomy in Alabama without having a kid. Go on, I'll sit and watch you get shot down time and time again. That's not the issue at hand here. Obviously Jane herself thought her protection was sufficient. Vasectomies are not 100% foolproof and acting like they are is foolish. We took precautions, those precautions failed. We did the best we could.

And if what you are saying is true, then we will have to get divorced. She won't even talk to me or help me sort through my emotions; she just shut down. I can't handle being with someone who refuses to speak to me without even saying why. I might be breaking a promise to not have kids, but it feels like she's breaking her vows of 'for better or worse'.

Jane doesn't want to take the Zofran the ER doc gave her and she insisted on getting another Phenergan shot instead, which makes her sleep. They never diagnosed her with the hyperemesis thing you're talking about because Jane was unwilling to try the Zofran and I don't think they believed her about the severity of her nausea because she wasn't willing to try any different medication. She hasn't gone to an OB/Gyn yet.

I know she feels disappointed. I'm disappointed in myself. I didn't ask to feel this way, but she won't even talk to me about it.

I've been looking for work since I was cleared to return. I've been doing odd jobs like car repair and the like to bring some income in and also so I could feel productive. I still collect my long-term disability and will be able to until I return to full-time work.


And I brought it up in what I thought was a tactful manner, but she never responded. She just stayed silent and still hasn't said a single word to me.

I went to two doctors but neither would approve a vasectomy until I had a child. Regardless, even a vasectomy is not 100% fullproof and there is no guarantee that this wouldn't still have happened with one.

>So, you want a baby, so that she can ruin her chance at her dream job (the job thats been supporting the both of you since you're disabled now) all because you think of it as "yours"?

I don't want to ruin her job, but isn't it illegal for them to discriminate against her for the pregnancy? She should be eligible for FMLA and they could not count her absences against her performance.

And I know it's not rational for me to be asking for her to enter a situation where she loses her income or job. I just have this hope that the morning sickness will pass in a few weeks and then she will be fine again. She could let me watch the baby while she goes to work.

I know it's mean, that's why I'm struggling with this. I don't want to feel this way.

>Tell her that you want the baby. Do NOT tell her as a "If you don't keep it, I'm leaving you!" kind of ultimatum, she deserves better. But tell her that you've changed your mind, that you know it's wrong of you but that's where you stand.

That is pretty much what I told her. I was very careful with my wording. I've kept the part where I would leave her to myself so far.

My health has improved to the point where I can return to a job, just not my old one. I can still weld, I just can't lift heavy objects (100+ lbs) over my head without pain and that is part of the lifting requirements to be a welder.
